name: 92354 · Loma Linda, CA
findings: ZIP 92354 (Loma Linda) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92354 (Loma Linda) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92354 (Loma Linda) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
